title: Sell More, Play Less: Benchmarking LLM Realistic Selling Skill
abstract: arXiv:2604.07054v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sales dialogues require multi-turn, goal-directed persuasion under asymmetric incentives, which makes them a challenging setting for large language models (LLMs). Yet existing dialogue benchmarks rarely measure deal progression and outcomes. We introduce SalesLLM benchmark, a bilingual (ZH/EN) benchmark derived from realistic applications covering Financial Services and Consumer Goods, built from 30,074 scripted configurations and 1,805 curated multi-turn scenarios with controllable difficulty and personas. We propose a fully automatic evaluation pipeline that combines (i) an LLM judge for sales-process progress, and (ii) fine-tuned BERT classifiers for end-of-dialogue buying intent. To improve simulation fidelity, we train a user model, CustomerLM, with SFT and DPO on 8,000+ crowdworker-involved sales conversations, reducing role inversion from 17.44% (GPT-4o) to 8.8%. SalesLLM benchmark scores correlate strongly with human ratings

translated_title: 卖得更多，聊得更少：基准测试LLM真实销售技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.07054v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：销售对话需要在不对称激励下进行多轮、目标导向的说服，这使得它们成为大型语言模型（LLMs）的一个具有挑战性的场景。然而，现有的对话基准很少衡量交易进展和结果。我们引入了SalesLLM基准，这是一个源自现实应用的双语（中/英）基准，涵盖金融服务和消费品，由30,074个脚本化配置和1,805个精心策划的多轮场景构建，具有可控难度和人物角色。我们提出了一个全自动评估流程，结合了（i）用于销售过程进展的LLM评判器，和（ii）用于对话结束购买意图的微调BERT分类器。为了提高模拟保真度，我们训练了一个用户模型CustomerLM，使用SFT和DPO在8,000多个涉及众包工作人员的销售对话上，将角色反转率从17.44%（GPT-4o）降低到8.8%。SalesLLM基准得分与人工评分高度相关。
tldr: 本文提出了SalesLLM，一个双语真实销售基准和自动评估流程，通过训练CustomerLM用户模型降低角色反转率，有效衡量LLM在销售对话中的交易进展和结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SalesLLM, a bilingual realistic sales benchmark with an automatic evaluation pipeline, and trains CustomerLM to reduce role inversion, effectively measuring LLM deal progression and outcomes in sales dialogues.
